prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1137; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with the identity of any other policies, including excess or umbrella coverage, that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle owner.

Your insured has a duty to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair and salvage records, telematics data, witness statements, claim file notes, and any recorded statements. Please take immediate steps to ensure none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
